title: Triverse
tagline: Swipe to jump from path to path

fr.tagline: Trois cordes de lumière montent dans le vide. Swipe pour sauter de l’une à l’autre, gemmes contre mines.

en.tagline: Three ropes of light run up the void. Swipe to hop between them, gems against mines.

description: Three ropes of light run up the void, curling into loops and crossing each other. Swipe to hop the arrow from one to the next: gems and power-ups pay, mines and voids cost, and the run only ends when the third life does.
